title: LogDig
pitch: Your Pi history. A journal you can read. This is the real CLI, running in your browser on ten sample sessions.
disclosure: The real LogDig CLI runs in a WebContainers Node.js sandbox in your browser. Sessions are synthetic and a stand-in for Pi returns canned summaries, so nothing is sent to a model. Reload to start over.
welcome: [1mLogDig[0m turns saved Pi sessions into daily Markdown notes, grouped by project.
Ten sample sessions from the last two days are in ~/.pi/agent/sessions. Your journal is ~/vault.
logdig status                 what is journaled so far
logdig backfill --dry-run     preview: dates, files, cache hits
logdig backfill               journal them, four sessions at a time
